test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate passive form of the given sentence.**

Please do not pluck any flowers from the temple compound.

options.text: You are requested not to pluck any flowers from the temple compound.
No flowers can be plucked from the temple compound.
How can any flowers be plucked from the temple compound?
Let any flowers not to be plucked from the temple compound.

solution:
The correct answer is **'You are requested not to pluck any flowers from the temple compound.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the active voice of an imperative sentence.
 
• Imperative sentence: Imperative sentences are used to issue a command or instruction, make a request, or offer advice. Basically, they tell people what to do. 
 
• To convert an active voice of an imperative sentence into a passive voice, we need to look if the sentence is starting with a word such as 'please or kindly'.
 
• Example:
 
 
• Kindly wait here. (Active voice)
 
 
 
• Rule to convert these types of sentences:
 
 
• Please will be removed and in its place requested will be used.
 
• As the sentence doesn't contain any object, generally 'you' is taken as the object.
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• You are requested to wait here. (Passive voice)
 
 
 
• **'Do not' **changes to **'not to'**.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 

Correct sentence:__ *You are requested not to pluck any flowers from the temple compound.*
